doc.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tier List
doc.summary: The Yu-Gi-Oh! tier list, updated October 30, 2026: Angelechy is the only TCG Tier 1 deck, and Blitzclique and Angelechy lead Genesys. Ranked from 164,971 YGO Omega ladder matches.

infobox.caption: Angelechy Destrier, the most used card of the top TCG deck

blocks.md:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! tier list ranks the decks people are playing on the YGO Omega ranked ladders, using data through October 29, 2026. **Angelechy** sits alone in TCG Tier 1 with 10.6% of the meta and a 55.2% win rate. **Blitzclique** (4.5%, 60.7%) and **Angelechy** (3.3%, 60.4%) share Genesys Tier 1.

A tier here measures **how much a deck is played**, not how strong it is. Read each tier with its win rate. For what moved this week, read the [latest meta report](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-meta-report-october-30-2026); for the numbers as they change, the [live statistics page](/statistics).

The TCG ladder is 11 days into the 10.2026 season, with 121,902 matches from 12,233 players. The top deck holds 10.6% of the meta, and 32% of games come from decks outside all four tiers.

blocks.text: Which decks win more than their tier suggests?

blocks.md:
These Tier 3 and 4 decks post the best win rates outside the top of each ladder. Their samples are smaller, and the people playing them may be specialists, so treat them as leads to test, not as proof.

- **TCG:** Power Patron / Elfnote (55.7% ±1.3), Radiant Typhoon (54.9% ±0.8) and Power Patron (53.4% ±1.3)
- **Genesys:** Angelechy / Ashtra (59.9% ±2.4), Artmage (59.9% ±2.6) and Centur-Ion / Angelechy (59.7% ±2.8)

Best and worst matchup for each top deck against Tiers 1 to 3. A matchup is listed only when its whole 95% confidence interval sits on one side of 50%, with at least 300 games in TCG and 80 in Genesys.

### TCG matchups

| Deck | Best matchup | Worst matchup |
|---|---|---|
| Angelechy | Invoked, 59.0% (1,720 games) | Radiant Typhoon, 44.3% (2,086 games) |
| HERO | Blitzclique, 56.3% (1,178 games) | Artmage / Power Patron, 45.2% (1,009 games) |
| Sky Striker | None clear | Blitzclique, 43.4% (1,135 games) |
| Elfnote | Blue-Eyes / Primite, 59.8% (453 games) | None clear |
| Light and Darkness Ritual | Blue-Eyes / Primite, 57.9% (401 games) | Elfnote, 43.0% (1,092 games) |
| Blitzclique | Invoked, 58.5% (583 games) | HERO, 43.7% (1,178 games) |

### Genesys matchups

| Deck | Best matchup | Worst matchup |
|---|---|---|
| Blitzclique | Shaddoll, 73.6% (87 games) | None clear |
| Angelechy | Paleozoic, 71.1% (97 games) | Blitzclique, 44.0% (389 games) |
| Hecahands | Dragon Ruler, 62.0% (113 games) | Blitzclique, 44.4% (331 games) |
| HERO | Paleozoic, 60.2% (98 games) | Angelechy, 39.4% (246 games) |
| Dragon Ruler | None clear | Angelechy, 33.6% (140 games) |
| Labrynth | None clear | Blitzclique, 33.5% (179 games) |

Generic Main Deck cards seen across at least two archetypes, by share of deck-games. In TCG, [Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring](/wiki/card/14558127) shows up in 89.1% of decks, and [Mulcharmy Fuwalos](/wiki/card/42141493) shows up in 83.5% of decks.
In Genesys, [Skull Meister](/wiki/card/67750322) shows up in 28.4% of decks, and [Ghost Ogre & Snow Rabbit](/wiki/card/59438930) shows up in 27.1% of decks.

Every number comes from ranked matches played on [YGO Omega](/wiki/ygo-omega-wiki), the same data behind our [statistics page](/statistics). Nothing is voted on or picked by hand.

**Tiers follow meta share, measured against the most played deck of the season:**

| Tier | Share compared with the top deck |
|---|---|
| Tier 1 | 60% or more |
| Tier 2 | 30% to 60% |
| Tier 3 | 15% to 30% |
| Tier 4 | 5% to 15% |

A deck also needs at least 0.5% of the meta to get a tier at all, so the top deck is always Tier 1 and a small format can't fill its tiers with fringe decks.

- **Meta share** is the deck's share of deck-games. Each game counts once per player, and mirror matches count.
- **Win rate** leaves mirror matches out, because a mirror always wins exactly half. The ± is its 95% confidence interval.
- **Decks** are grouped by the archetypes they run, so a hybrid counts apart from pure builds.
- **Seasons:** each ladder has its own season, so TCG and Genesys cover different date ranges.

blocks.title: What this list can't tell you
blocks.md: This is ladder play on a simulator, not tournament results. Players of every level are in it. It shows what you will face on the ladder, which is not always what wins a premier event.

items.q: What is the best Yu-Gi-Oh! deck right now?
items.md: On the TCG ladder, Angelechy, with a 55.2% win rate at 10.6% of the meta. It has the strongest win rate once sample size is counted.

items.q: What is the best Genesys deck right now?
items.md: Megalith / Magnet, with a 64.9% win rate at 0.3% of the meta. It has the strongest win rate once sample size is counted.

items.q: Is this tier list based on tournament results?
items.md: No. It comes from ranked ladder matches on YGO Omega. That gives a far larger sample than tournaments, but it reflects ladder play, not premier events.
By meta share compared with the most played deck: 60% of its share or more is Tier 1, 30% is Tier 2, 15% is Tier 3 and 5% is Tier 4. Decks under 0.5% of the meta get no tier.

items.q: Does a higher tier mean a stronger deck?
items.md: Not always. Tiers measure popularity. Sky Striker is TCG Tier 2 with a 48.7% win rate, while Power Patron / Elfnote is Tier 4 at 55.7%.

items.q: How much does going first matter?
items.md: Going first wins 53.5% of games on the TCG ladder and 56.8% in Genesys.

items.q: How often is the tier list updated?
items.md: Every week, on this same page. Each week also gets its own [meta report](/wiki/yu-gi-oh-meta-report-october-30-2026), and the [statistics page](/statistics) shows the current numbers for TCG and [Genesys](/statistics?ladder=genesys) between updates.

items.q: Where can I see decklists for these decks?
items.md: The [statistics page](/statistics) has sample decklists, card usage and full matchup tables for each deck.
